DIRECT.description: Evaluate the stated rule as written.

INVERTED.description: Evaluate the logical complement of the stated rule outcome.

polarity_semantics.unknown_law: Negating an unresolved proposition does not manufacture a known truth value; ABSTAIN remains ABSTAIN.

swarm_review.generator_role: Constructed polarity-matched minimal pairs while keeping scenario, realized mapping and display order fixed inside each pair.
swarm_review.semantic_reviewer: Confirmed DIRECT identity, INVERTED ALLOW<->DENY, and ABSTAIN invariance under unresolved truth.
swarm_review.shortcut_hunter: Rejected any design where polarity frequency, template identity, symbol family or display order predicts target independently of scenario plus episode mapping.
swarm_review.statistical_reviewer: Full successor must cross query polarity independently with semantic scenario, all six S3 mappings, all six display orders and template family; nuisance-only prediction must remain at chance under preregistered tests.
swarm_review.split_reviewer: Polarity pairs belong to the same causal/counterfactual family and must never be separated across TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT.
swarm_review.abi_reviewer: ATOM_A/B/C are logical aliases only. Exact accepted one-token ABI atoms and frozen tokenizer identity are required before materialization.

full_factorial_requirement.training_only_if_four_train_templates: 4 templates x 3 semantic states x 6 S3 mappings x 6 display orders x 2 query polarities = 864 logical rows before hard negatives
full_factorial_requirement.retained_six_template_scaffold_including: 6 templates x 3 semantic states x 6 S3 mappings x 6 display orders x 2 query polarities = 1296 logical rows before hard negatives
full_factorial_requirement.pair_integrity: For every fixed scenario + mapping + display order + template cell, DIRECT and INVERTED must coexist in the same causal family.
full_factorial_requirement.counterfactual_target_law: Known true/false targets flip through the episode-local mapping under INVERTED; unresolved targets remain unchanged.

required_validator_delta: Fail if any fixed scenario/mapping/display-order/template cell lacks both DIRECT and INVERTED polarity variants.
Fail if DIRECT and INVERTED paired rows cross dataset splits.
Fail if INVERTED does not swap known ALLOW/DENY target semantics exactly through the realized codebook.
Fail if ABSTAIN changes under polarity inversion without new evidence.

Compute nuisance-only decoder accuracy over template, mapping id, display order, polarity marker and symbol family; reject if it predicts the semantic scenario or target above preregistered chance tolerance without reading scenario content.
Keep exact verified ABI atom, tokenizer-count, last-token-position, family/provenance and holdout-freeze gates unchanged.
research_feedback: The training target is increasingly specific: content-dependent semantic-state reading must be composed with an episode-local codebook and an independently varying query operator.
The repeated discovery of higher-order shortcuts shows that marginal balance is insufficient; conditional/factorial nuisance independence must be a first-class dataset invariant.

For future HCU/J-Space training traces, counterfactual operator changes should be represented as causal families rather than independent rows, so the harness can test function composition rather than memorization.
next_exact_action: Fuse query polarity into the single retained order-crossed Trigger-2 generator and its cross-split leak guard; then run exact factorial/pair-integrity/nuisance-only-decoder validators before any ABI atom materialization or training admission.
